sentences.text:
For the petitioners:
r to _________________________________________________________________ Mr. Sanjeev Kumar Suri, Advocate.
For the respondents: Mr. Rupinder Singh Thakur, Mr. Y.P.S.Dhaulta and Mr. Navlesh Verma,
Additional Advocates General with Ms. Seema Sharma, Deputy Advocate General, for respondents No. 1 to 3.
HC Parveen Lata, No.28, I.O. Women Police Station, Una, District Una, H.P. present with record.
Jyotsna Rewal Dua, Judge

The petitioners have prayed for quashing of FIR No.26 of 2022, dated 07.09.2022, registered under Sections 498A, 406 read with Section 34 of Indian Penal Code, at Women Police Station Una, District Una, H.P.
Whether reporters of Local Papers may be allowed to see the judgment?
2. Respondents No. 1 to 3 have filed the status report.

3. At this stage, learned counsel for the petitioners .
submits that he is under instructions to withdraw the present petition.
Accordingly, the present petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
Pending miscellaneous application(s), if any, also stand disposed of.
